-A Catholic hospital doesn't want to follow California's law requiring emergency abortions because they "answer to a higher power"

A Republican-appointed agency in Georgia has accused the two women running for state Supreme Court of violating judicial ethics rules. 

How? By talking about abortion. 

Oh, and the commission decided to make that claim public two days before the election

But let’s not lose sight of the fact that this is conservatives’ way of kicking the can down the road, and we still have lots of work to do.

(Btw, Abortion, Every Day broke that news about the FDA doing a bullshit review)
Here's why some providers are going to continue shipping mifepristone until they hear otherwise from a federal agency

If you need abortion pills now, you can still get them. By mail!   

Republicans are counting on chaos and confusion to prevent women from getting the care they need. It's important we don't let that happen.

You're about to see headlines saying abortion pills can't be shipped. THAT IS NOT TRUE  

You can still get abortion pills by mail to all fifty states.   

Some providers will switch to miso-only, some will ship both mife & miso. I got into all of this when the federal court ruling first dropped on my S*ubstack.
SCOTUS is really on my last fucking nerve. They're waiting until right at 5pm to release a decision on mifepristone?? Come on now

The nerve of claiming that moms.gov is there to help mothers!

Video

This isn't a one-off, and the threat of removing women's children isn't just happening in banned states.   

In the same article, I write about a mother who was investigated by both CPS and the police for helping her teenager get an abortion *in a pro-choice state.*

Full story is on my S*bstack now
Let's be clear: Republicans won’t need laws criminalizing out-of-state abortion travel if they can use the threat of family separation to terrify parents into submission.

Child protective services ripped a 14-year-old from her home to stop her from leaving the state for an abortion.

They also threatened her mother with murder charges and the removal of her other child if they crossed state lines for care.

So please don't tell me Republicans aren't banning travel.

Over 60% of women who have abortions are already mothers, and they are making that decision in the best interest of their existing children.

Happy Mother’s Day.
